title: Pi-hole Ad-Block Effectiveness
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pihole:query
| stats count as total, sum(eval(blocked="true")) as blocked
| eval block_rate=round(100*blocked/total,1)
description: Calculates what percentage of your household's DNS requests Pi-hole blocked, the satisfying number that shows your ad-blocker earning its keep.
value: A visible block rate proves the value of network-wide ad blocking and helps you tune blocklists for the right balance.
implementation: Forward the Pi-hole query log to HEC; schedule daily and trend the block rate over time.
visualization: Gauge of block rate with a trend line.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what share of ads and trackers your network blocker stopped, which is very satisfying to watch.
